notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Hello,
community "Outside"! We would like to inform you that we have decided to release the game and prepared an update for you. After the release, we do not plan to update the game in the near future, but will be for some time to go update any problems. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31155093/01ca57ed2ce64408ba95435884c749cfee6f9446.gif
With respect Evil Games!

notes.title: Transfer of release date due to:
notes.notes:
Friends! We want to inform you that the release of the game from early access is delayed due to the release of our new game Typical Nightmare (aug 13). This is a narrative horror based on the theory of psychoanalysis. Soon, we will resume work on Outside, and we will gladden you with a worked history and new location.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155093/a580322616eaf34cacfb501e508a06b397fa02ea.png

notes.title: Final update of early access
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we want to inform you that this update will be the last for this card, since our team is preparing the final, full game changing, update, release.
What we are preparing for you on this update: 

- New map (completely changed setting and graphics, you will be transferred to the USSR pioneer camp)
- The plot company (we do not depart from the canon of the maniac, but we are engaged in its development, we will soon devote you to the case and launch a closed test)
- Cooperative story company
- Multiplayer mode (its modes and features we'll disclose a little later)
- Change of hero and villain (the hero and villain will be changed to the setting of the new card)
More detailed description of the update and screenshots, we will publish later.

And now on the last update on this map. 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155093/7ece58d85db018c82032376595d591a8ef9bcb72.png
Update v0.0.3
- Changing the map
- Adding language (ru)
- New places on the map
- Complicating the gameplay

This is where the changes in the update come to an end, in the future there will be fixes and small changes for requests in the steam community, but there will be no changes on the map any more.
New Year's update will be removed at the end of this month.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155093/12c00f727dfc15fa5a0f5183ac5aeeaefc0e8e3f.jpg

Thank you for your attention and enjoy the game!

Sincerely, EvilGames

notes.title: New Year's update!
notes.notes:
The update will be released before the first day.
Let's say a little about what will be included in the upcoming update:

-Processed map (The whole map will be processed in the winter version)
-Addition to the location (Church)
-The animals are processed
-Healers (Wolves)
-Weather effects

At the moment, this is all we can tell you!
Thank you for watching the game and Merry Christmas!
